en.tipUploadPath: TIP: The upload path format is "address/path", such as"ftp://192.168.1.10/record"
en.tipUploadWay: TIP: 1. leisure, upload when no other tasks are executed.2. real time, upload as long as any file is not synchronized. 3. timing, means that synchronize files within the specified time.
en.thirdPartyCentralizedControl: Upload to the third-party centralized control platform

zh.tipUploadPath: TIP: 上传路径格式为"地址/路径", 如"ftp://192.168.1.10/record"
zh.tipUploadWay: TIP: 1、闲时上传, 是指录播主机在无其他任务执行时, 进行录像文件同步。2、实时上传, 是指只要有文件未同步完成, 就会进行文件同步。3、定时上传, 是指在指定时间内进行文件同步。
zh.thirdPartyCentralizedControl: 上传至第三方集中控制平台
zh.uploadByUsername: 根据用户名上传不同目录
zh.filmOnly: 只上传电影模式的录像
